meta.title: FAQ — frequently asked questions about REDi FIT
meta.description: Answers to the most common questions about REDi FIT: account, bookings, payments, events, and the subscription and work for trainers in the app.

hero.lead: Learn how REDi FIT works, how to book sessions, use payments and manage your account. Here you'll find answers to the questions most often asked by both people who train and trainers.

client.title: Questions most often asked by people who train

account.title: Account and the REDi FIT app

q1.q: Is REDi FIT free to use?
q1.a: Yes. The REDi FIT app is free for people who train. You only pay for the sessions and sports events you choose, at the prices set by the trainers.

q2.q: Do I need an account to book a session?
q2.a: Yes. To book a session, download the REDi FIT app and register as a client. This way you can easily view your bookings and event sign-ups.

q3.q: Can I use REDi FIT in different cities?
q3.a: Yes. You can search for trainers in any location you choose, wherever you are at the moment. The availability of services depends on trainers' offers in a given city.

q4.q: What languages is the REDi FIT app available in?
q4.a: The app is available in Polish, English and Ukrainian. You can choose the language when you first open the app or change it later in the settings.

q5.q: Which phones does REDi FIT work on?
q5.a: REDi FIT is a mobile app for Android and iOS devices. You can download it from Google Play or the App Store.

q6.q: How do I find a personal trainer or sports instructor?
q6.a: Choose the training category, location and time you're interested in. REDi FIT will show you available trainers, whom you can browse on a list or an interactive map.

q7.q: How do I choose the right trainer?
q7.a: Check their specialisation, experience, qualifications, portfolio, client reviews and the services and prices they offer. This makes it easier to choose someone who matches your needs.

q8.q: Can I find a trainer near me?
q8.a: Yes. In the “Nearby trainers” section you can search for trainers close to you. You set the search radius yourself.

q9.q: Can I book a session for the same day?
q9.a: Yes, if the trainer has free slots. In the “Train today” section you'll find sessions you can still book for the same day.

q10.q: Can a trainer come to my home or another location?
q10.a: Yes, if they offer mobile sessions. You'll find information about travel and the area covered in the trainer's offer.

q11.q: Can I save my favourite trainers?
q11.a: Yes. You can add trainers to your favourites to easily return to their profiles and check available sessions.

q12.q: How do I book a session on REDi FIT?
q12.a: Choose a trainer, the service you're interested in and a convenient time. Then choose an available payment method and confirm the booking in the app.

q13.q: How can I pay for a session?
q13.a: You can use the available online payment methods or pay in cash if the trainer offers this option. You'll see the available payment methods when booking.

q14.q: Can I cancel or reschedule a session?
q14.a: Whether you can cancel or reschedule depends on the rules the trainer has set for a given service. Before booking, read the cancellation and refund terms.

q15.q: Where can I find my training history?
q15.a: In the app you can view upcoming, completed and cancelled bookings, as well as the history of your sports event sign-ups.

q16.q: Can I book another session with the same trainer?
q16.a: Yes. The “Book again” feature lets you quickly return to a chosen service and make another booking.

q17.q: Do I have to pay extra for gym entry if the session takes place at a gym?
q17.a: It depends on the trainer's offer and the rules of the gym. In some cases gym entry is included in the price of the session; in others it may require an extra fee or a membership. Before booking, check the details of the offer or contact the trainer.

q18.q: Can I try a free trial session?
q18.a: Some trainers offer free trial sessions so you can get to know them and see whether their training style suits you. You can check whether such sessions are available in the chosen trainer's offer.

q19.q: Can I sign up for sports events on REDi FIT?
q19.a: Yes! In the app you'll find sports events organised by trainers. You can check the date, location, price and available spots, and then sign up for the event you choose. Some events are free, so you can take part at no cost.

trainer.title: Questions most often asked by trainers

q1.q: Is REDi FIT free for trainers?
q1.a: Yes! To start with, you can use REDi FIT for free during a trial period. After it ends, you move to a paid subscription according to the current price list. You'll find the details on the Pricing page.

q2.q: How much does REDi FIT cost after the free period?
q2.a: After the free period ends, a monthly subscription applies. You'll find the amount on the Pricing page. The fee is fixed and doesn't depend on the number of clients or booked sessions.

q3.q: How do I create a trainer account on REDi FIT?
q3.a: Download the REDi FIT app from the App Store or Google Play and choose to register as a trainer. Then complete your profile, add the services you offer, set prices and availability, and set up your account to accept online payments.

q4.q: Do I need to run a registered business to use REDi FIT?
q4.a: Not always. It's worth consulting an accountant or tax adviser to find out whether you are required to register a business in your situation.

q5.q: How do I pay for the REDi FIT subscription?
q5.a: The subscription works as a recurring payment. Just link a payment card to your account and the fee will be charged automatically every month, with no need to make transfers.

clients.title: Winning clients and your training offer

q6.q: How does REDi FIT help me win new clients?
q6.a:
Your profile is visible in the trainer search, on the interactive map and in the “Nearby trainers” section. This way, people looking for training can find your offer, check available times and book a session.

You can also organise sports events, such as group sessions, to showcase your skills, reach more potential clients and encourage them to keep working with you.

q7.q: Do I need to advertise my services separately?
q7.a: No. Your profile and training offer are available to REDi FIT app users.

q8.q: Can I offer different types of training?
q8.a: Yes! You can add various sports services to your offer and set their length, price and location. This lets clients choose the session that best suits their needs.

q9.q: Can I run sessions in different locations?
q9.a: Yes. You can offer sessions at a gym, a fitness studio, outdoors or at the client's place. You decide where you provide your services.

q10.q: Can I offer free trial sessions?
q10.a: Yes! You can add a free trial session to your offer so new clients can get to know your training style. You can also organise a free sports event, such as a group session, to showcase your skills and reach more potential clients.

q11.q: What are Happy Hours and how can I use them?
q11.a: Happy Hours let you offer sessions at discounted prices at selected times. With this feature you can encourage clients to book at times when you have fewer sessions and make better use of your calendar.

q12.q: Can I use REDi FIT if I already have my own clients?
q12.a: Yes! You can use REDi FIT both to win new clients and to organise sessions with people you already work with. The booking calendar makes it easier to manage your schedule.

q13.q: Can I set my own session prices?
q13.a: Yes. You set the prices of your services, session length and available times yourself. You can also use Happy Hours to offer selected sessions at discounted prices.

q14.q: Can I change my offer after creating an account?
q14.a: Yes. You can update your profile, services, prices and availability so the information clients see reflects your current business.

q15.q: Can I see clients' reviews of my sessions?
q15.a: Yes. Reviews left by clients are visible on your profile. They help build credibility and make it easier for new people to decide to book a session.

q16.q: Can I use REDi FIT if I only train clients on the side, e.g. after work or at weekends?
q16.a: Yes! You don't have to train clients full time. You set your own availability, so you can offer sessions only on selected days or at selected times, fitting your schedule to what works for you.

q17.q: Can I set my own working hours and available times?
q17.a: Yes. You manage your calendar yourself and set your working hours and the availability of individual services. Clients can only book sessions at the times you make available.

q18.q: What if I go on holiday or stop training clients for a while?
q18.a: You can block selected days or periods in your calendar so clients can't book sessions while you're away.

q19.q: Can I limit how far in advance clients can book?
q19.a: Yes. You can set your own booking rules, including how far in advance clients can sign up for sessions.

q20.q: Can clients cancel or change bookings?
q20.a: Yes. As a trainer, you set your own cancellation rules – for example, you can decide that clients can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the session starts.

q21.a: Yes. On REDi FIT you have access to your client list and can contact clients by text messages sent from your phone. It's a convenient way to share information about sessions, schedule changes or available times.

q22.q: Can I set a break between sessions?
q22.a: Yes! If you need time to travel to your next client, prepare equipment or rest between sessions, you can set breaks between bookings. This makes it easier to plan your day and avoid overlapping appointments.

q23.q: Can I see who has signed up for my sessions?
q23.a: Yes. In the app you have access to bookings and your client list, so you can check scheduled sessions and manage your work.

q24.q: How do I get paid for sessions paid online?
q24.a: Online payments are handled by an external payment operator. Once you've set up your payout account, the money for paid sessions is transferred according to the operator's schedule and rules.

q25.a: Yes. You can let clients pay in cash directly at the session. You decide which payment methods you offer for your services.

q26.q: Do I have access to my payment history and financial reports?
q26.a: Yes. REDi FIT lets you view your payment history and reports that help you keep track of your income and manage settlements related to your sessions.

q27.q: Does REDi FIT charge a commission on bookings?
q27.a:
REDi FIT doesn't charge a commission on session bookings. As a trainer, you pay a fixed subscription according to the current price list, whether you have 5 or 20 clients.

For online payments, only a transaction processing fee applies, charged according to the current price list.

q28.q: Can I organise sports events through REDi FIT?
q28.a: Yes! You can create sports events such as group sessions, workshops or outdoor classes. You set their date, location, price and number of available spots. It's a great way to present your offer to more potential clients.

q29.q: Can I organise free sports events?
q29.a: Yes. You can organise both paid and free sports events. A free group session can be a great opportunity to showcase your skills and connect with new clients.

q30.q: Can I limit the number of event participants?
q30.a: Yes. When creating an event, you set the maximum number of participants. This lets you match the group size to the type of training and the space available.

q31.q: Who is responsible for injuries that may happen during a session?
q31.a:
The trainer who organises and delivers the service is responsible for running the session properly and safely. REDi FIT is a platform that connects trainers with clients and enables bookings; it is not the organiser or provider of the sports activities.

It's worth having appropriate third-party liability insurance for personal trainers or sports instructors, which can provide financial protection in case of claims related to participants' injuries.

q32.q: Who is responsible for the legality of the place where I hold a session or sports event?
q32.a:
The trainer organising the session or sports event is responsible for choosing a suitable place and following its rules.

As a trainer, you must follow the rules of gyms and fitness clubs and the regulations for using public spaces such as parks, squares and other outdoor areas. If running classes requires the consent of the owner or manager of the area, or a permit, you should obtain it before the session or event starts.

REDi FIT provides tools for presenting your offer and handling bookings, but is not responsible for choosing locations or obtaining the required permissions.
